cohort: Exactly two known local caller labels across raw exact REC; valid whole current and immediate next annotated focal coda in one continuity span; four completed partner codas required for every model.
continuity: Order all raw events by onset then source line within exact REC. Unknown onset/caller makes REC ineligible. Rejected rows, same-caller overlapping or precision-ambiguous onset intervals, and repeated events within a nine-character file are barriers; exclude valid calls crossing a barrier. Break on consecutive onset gaps >60s, including rounding uncertainty. Never bridge REC or skip an invalid next focal event.
precision: Half last written decimal unit for onset; sum half units of true ICIs for duration. Completion before cutoff and target onset after cutoff require disjoint rounding envelopes (strict > plus 1e-12). Current coda defines cutoff exactly as onset + ICI sum. This operational rounding guard is not timing accuracy.
features: features-v1.json; no source IDs, labels, target timing or full-recording statistics as predictors. Features built from completed prefix before retrospective target eligibility.
historyOrder: Annotated onset then source line; ambiguous same-caller ordering is a barrier. Current plus latest prior completed focal. Latest two completed partner codas for M2; skip those two and use preceding two for separately fitted M2-lagged. Keep original donor timestamps.

folds.allocation: Lexicographically sorted eligible six-character parent roots, index modulo min(5, group count); independent of target values and class balance.

target.boundaries: short <= low; medium > low and <= high; long > high; training target durations only

multinomial: scikit-learn 1.7.2 lbfgs with all three training classes; omit deprecated multi_class argument; separate fresh pipeline for each model/fold; no tuning

probabilities.handling: Store raw; floor each class at epsilon then renormalize identically for all models; retain clipped-class and affected-row counts

primary: mean(log2(p_M2[y]) - log2(p_M1[y])) in bits per evaluated coda; pooled sample weighting

bootstrap.weighting: Uniform parent-group draws with replacement; retain all paired rows for each draw, including multiplicity; pooled sample-weighted and secondary group-macro gain on the same draws. No refitting.

examples.rule: First eligible example in source-line order from each lexicographically sorted eligible parent group, take first five groups; frozen in split manifest before scoring

failureRules: Fewer than three eligible parent groups: insufficient-data, null aggregate
Collapsed training quantile edges or missing training class: fail whole run; retain fold failure, no successful-fold-only mean
Nonconvergence or nonfinite/invalid probability: fail whole run; no alternative solver
Changed pinned inputs or unfrozen producer inputs: refuse execution
No score-based model, threshold, seed, lag or example selection
limitations: Conditional on an eligible subsequent recorded focal coda; does not predict whether a call happens or establish a reply.
Six-character roots coalesce author file/traversal and sensor groupings; they are not certified independent encounters or animal identities. Histories never cross exact REC.
The 60-second gap and rounding envelopes are conservative operational rules, not biological bout boundaries or timing accuracy.
Group bootstrap intervals are conditional/descriptive for this fitted cross-validation exercise, omit model-refit uncertainty and cannot establish encounter independence; few groups limit coverage.

Older context is not an exchangeable permutation null. Shared setting, tempo drift, types, recency and selection remain confounds; no p-value, causal transfer entropy, biological rate or meaning claim.
Archive has 3840 rows; correspondence to the paper's 3948-coda subset remains unresolved. No field WAV to annotation mapping or independent human annotation review is claimed.
Later held-out examples may use earlier observed history from that REC; models, bins and preprocessing remain frozen from other groups.
